state.title: All ChemCam data and corrected Li data
state.description: Supplementary data for JGR manuscript "Boron and Lithium in Calcium Sulfate Veins: Tracking Precipitation of Diagenetic Materials in Vera Rubin Ridge, Gale Crater". Excel files contain all LIBS data collected by the Curiosity rover between sol 1-2311 and corrected Li data for vein targets.
